1.text: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand 2 set forth in order a declaration of dose things which r most surely believed among us,
Even as dey delivered ’em 2 us, which from tha beginning were eyewitnesses, N ministers of tha word;
It seemed good 2 me also, havin had perfect understanding of all things from tha very first, 2 write 2 u in order, most excellent Theophilus,
Dat u might know tha certainty of dose things, in which u have been instructed.
There was in tha days of Herod, tha king of Judæa, a certain priest named Zacharias, of tha course of Abia: N his wife was of tha daughters of Aaron, N her name was Elisabeth.
N dey were both righteous before God, walkin in all tha commandments N ordinances of tha Lord blameless.
N dey had no child, because dat Elisabeth was barren, N dey both were now well stricken in years.
N it happened, dat while he executed tha priest’s office before God in tha order of his course,
According 2 tha custom of tha priest’s office, his lot was 2 burn incense when he went in2 tha temple of tha Lord.
N tha whole crowd of tha people were prayin without at tha time of incense.
N there appeared 2 him an angel of tha Lord standin on tha right side of tha altar of incense.
N when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, N fear fell upon him.
But tha angel said 2 him, don’t fear, Zacharias: 4 ur prayer is heard; N ur wife Elisabeth shall bear u a son, N u will call his name John.
N u will have joy N gladness; N many shall rejoice at his birth.
4 he shall be great in tha sight of tha Lord, N shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; N he shall be filled wit tha Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.
N many of tha children of Israel shall he turn 2 tha Lord their God.
N he shall go before him in tha spirit N power of Elias, 2 turn tha hearts of tha fathers 2 tha children, N tha disobedient 2 tha wisdom of tha just; 2 make ready a people prepared 4 tha Lord.
N Zacharias said 2 tha angel, Whereby shall I know dis? 4 I am an old man, N my wife well stricken in years.
N tha angel answerin said 2 him, I am Gabriel, dat stand in tha presence of God; N am sent 2 speak 2 u, N 2 show u dese glad tidings.
N, look, u will be dumb, N not able 2 speak, until tha day dat dese things shall be performed, because u believe not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
N tha people waited 4 Zacharias, N marvelled dat he tarried so long in tha temple.
N when he came out, he could not speak 2 ’em: N dey perceived dat he had seen a vision in tha temple: 4 he beckoned 2 ’em, N remained speechless.
N it happened, dat, as soon as tha days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed 2 his own house.
N after dose days his wife Elisabeth conceived, N hid herself five months, sayin,
Like dis has tha Lord dealt wit me in tha days in which he looked on me, 2 take away my reproach among men.
N in tha sixth month tha angel Gabriel was sent from God 2 a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
2 a virgin espoused 2 a man whose name was Joseph, of tha house of David; N tha virgin’s name was Mary.
N tha angel came in 2 her, N said, Hail, u dat art highly favoured, tha Lord is wit u: blessed r u among women.
N when she saw him, she was troubled at his sayin, N cast in her mind what manner of greeting dis should be.
N tha angel said 2 her, don’t fear, Mary: 4 u have found favour wit God.
N, look, u will conceive in ur womb, N bring forth a son, N will call his name JESUS.
He shall be great, N shall be called tha Son of tha Highest: N tha Lord God shall give 2 him tha throne of his father David:
N he shall reign over tha house of Jacob 4 ever; N of his kingdom there shall be no end.
Then said Mary 2 tha angel, How shall dis be, seein I know not a man?
N tha angel answered 2 her, tha Holy Ghost shall come upon u, N tha power of tha Highest shall overshadow u: therefore also dat holy thing which shall be born of u shall be called tha Son of God.
N, look, ur cousin Elisabeth, she has also conceived a son in her old age: N dis is tha sixth month wit her, who was called barren.
4 wit God nothing shall be impossible.
N Mary said, look tha handmaid of tha Lord; be it 2 me according 2 ur word. N tha angel departed from her.
N Mary arose in dose days, N went in2 tha hill country wit haste, in2 a city of Juda;
N entered in2 tha house of Zacharias, N greeted Elisabeth.
N it happened, dat, when Elisabeth heard tha greeting of Mary, tha babe leaped in her womb; N Elisabeth was filled wit tha Holy Ghost:
N she spoke out wit a loud voice, N said, Blessed r u among women, N blessed is tha fruit of ur womb.
N from where is dis 2 me, dat tha mother of my Lord should come 2 me?
4, look, as soon as tha voice of ur greeting sounded in mine ears, tha babe leaped in my womb 4 joy.
N blessed is she dat believed: 4 there shall be a performance of dose things which were told her from tha Lord.
N Mary said, My soul does magnify tha Lord,
N my spirit has rejoiced in God my Saviour.
4 he has regarded tha low estate of his handmaiden: 4, look, from from now on all generations shall call me blessed.
4 he dat is mighty has done 2 me great things; N holy is his name.
N his mercy is on ’em dat fear him from generation 2 generation.
He has showed strength wit his arm; he has scattered tha proud in tha imagination of their hearts.
He has put down tha mighty from their seats, N exalted ’em of low degree.
He has filled tha hungry wit good things; N tha rich he has sent empty away.
He has helped his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
As he spoke 2 our fathers, 2 Abraham, N 2 his seed 4 ever.
N Mary stayed wit her about three months, N returned 2 her own house.
Now Elisabeth’s full time came dat she should be delivered; N she brought forth a son.
N her neighbours N her cousins heard how tha Lord had showed great mercy upon her; N dey rejoiced wit her.
N it happened, dat on tha eighth day dey came 2 circumcise tha child; N dey called him Zacharias, after tha name of his father.
N his mother answered, Not so; but he shall be called John.
N dey said 2 her, There is none of ur kindred dat is called by dis name.
N dey made signs 2 his father, how he would have him called.
N he asked 4 a writing table, N wrote, sayin, His name is John. N dey marvelled all.
N his mouth was opened right away, N his tongue loosed, N he spoke, N praised God.
N fear came on all dat lived round about ’em: N all dese sayings were noised abroad throughout all tha hill country of Judæa.
N all dey dat heard ’em laid ’em up in their hearts, sayin, What manner of child shall dis be! N tha hand of tha Lord was wit him.
N his father Zacharias was filled wit tha Holy Ghost, N prophesied, sayin,
Blessed be tha Lord God of Israel; 4 he has visited N redeemed his people,
N has raised up an horn of salvation 4 us in tha house of his servant David;
As he spoke by tha mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since tha world began:
Dat we should be saved from our opps, N from tha hand of all dat hate us;
2 perform tha mercy promised 2 our fathers, N 2 remember his holy covenant;
Tha oath which he sware 2 our father Abraham,
Dat he would grant 2 us, dat we bein delivered out of tha hand of our opps might serve him without fear,
In holiness N righteousness before him, all tha days of our life.
N u, child, will be called tha prophet of tha Highest: 4 u will go before tha face of tha Lord 2 prepare his ways;
2 give knowledge of salvation 2 his people by tha remission of their sins,
Through tha tender mercy of our God; whereby tha dayspring from on high has visited us,
2 give light 2 ’em dat sit in darkness N in tha shadow of death, 2 guide our feet in2 tha way of peace.
N tha child grew, N grew strong in spirit, N was in tha deserts till tha day of his shewing 2 Israel.

2.text: N it happened in dose days, dat there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus, dat all tha world should be taxed.
( N dis taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
N all went 2 be taxed, every one in2 his own city.
N Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of tha city of Nazareth, in2 Judæa, 2 tha city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of tha house N lineage of David:)
2 be taxed wit Mary his espoused wife, bein great wit child.
N so it was, dat, while dey were there, tha days were accomplished dat she should be delivered.
N she brought forth her firstborn son, N wrapped him in swaddling clothes, N laid him in a manger; because there was no room 4 ’em in tha inn.
N there were in tha same country shepherds abiding in tha field, keepin watch over their flock by night.
N, look, tha angel of tha Lord came upon ’em, N tha glory of tha Lord shone round about ’em: N dey were sore afraid.
N tha angel said 2 ’em, don’t fear: 4, look, I bring u good tidings of great joy, which shall be 2 all people.
4 2 u is born dis day in tha city of David a Saviour, which is Christ tha Lord.
N dis shall be a sign 2 u; y’all shall find tha babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lyin in a manger.
N suddenly there was wit tha angel a crowd of tha heavenly host praising God, N sayin,
Glory 2 God in tha highest, N on earth peace, good will toward men.

N it happened, as tha angels were gone away from ’em in2 heaven, tha shepherds said one 2 another, Let us now go even 2 Bethlehem, N see dis thing which is come 2 pass, which tha Lord has made known 2 us.
N dey came wit haste, N found Mary, N Joseph, N tha babe lyin in a manger.
N when dey had seen it, dey made known abroad tha sayin which was told ’em concerning dis child.
N all dey dat heard it wondered at dose things which were told ’em by tha shepherds.
But Mary kept all dese things, N pondered ’em in her heart.
N tha shepherds returned, glorifying N praising God 4 all tha things dat dey had heard N seen, as it was told 2 ’em.
N when eight days were accomplished 4 tha circumcising of tha child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of tha angel before he was conceived in tha womb.
N when tha days of her purification according 2 tha law of Moses were accomplished, dey brought him 2 Jerusalem, 2 present him 2 tha Lord;
(As it is written in tha law of tha Lord, Every male dat opens tha womb shall be called holy 2 tha Lord;)
N 2 offer a sacrifice according 2 dat which is said in tha law of tha Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
N, look, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; N tha same man was just N devout, waitin 4 tha consolation of Israel: N tha Holy Ghost was upon him.
N it was revealed 2 him by tha Holy Ghost, dat he should not see death, before he had seen tha Lord’s Christ.
N he came by tha Spirit in2 tha temple: N when tha parents brought in tha child Jesus, 2 do 4 him after tha custom of tha law,
Then took he him up in his arms, N blessed God, N said,
Lord, now lettest u ur servant depart in peace, according 2 ur word:
4 my eyes have seen ur salvation,
Which u have prepared before tha face of all people;
A light 2 lighten tha Gentiles, N tha glory of ur people Israel.
N Joseph N his mother marvelled at dose things which were spoken of him.
N Simeon blessed ’em, N said 2 Mary his mother, look, dis child is set 4 tha fall N risin again of many in Israel; N 4 a sign which shall be spoken against;
(yeah, a sword shall pierce through ur own soul also,) dat tha thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
N there was one Anna, a prophetess, tha daughter of Phanuel, of tha tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, N had lived wit an husband seven years from her virginity;
N she was a widow of about fourscore N four years, which departed not from tha temple, but served God wit fastings N prayers night N day.
N she comin in dat instant gave thanks likewise 2 tha Lord, N spoke of him 2 all ’em dat looked 4 redemption in Jerusalem.
N when dey had performed all things according 2 tha law of tha Lord, dey returned in2 Galilee, 2 their own city Nazareth.
N tha child grew, N grew strong in spirit, filled wit wisdom: N tha grace of God was upon him.
Now his parents went 2 Jerusalem every year at tha feast of tha passover.
N when he was twelve years old, dey went up 2 Jerusalem after tha custom of tha feast.
N when dey had fulfilled tha days, as dey returned, tha child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; N Joseph N his mother knew not of it.
But dey, supposing him 2 have been in tha company, went a day’s journey; N dey sought him among their kinsfolk N acquaintance.
N when dey found him not, dey turned back again 2 Jerusalem, seekin him.
N it happened, dat after three days dey found him in tha temple, sittin in tha midst of tha doctors, both hearin ’em, N asking ’em questions.
N all dat heard him were astonished at his understanding N answers.
N when dey saw him, dey were amazed: N his mother said 2 him, Son, why have u like dis dealt wit us? look, ur father N I have sought u sorrowing.
N he said 2 ’em, How is it dat y’all sought me? knew y’all not dat I must be about my Father’s business?
N dey understood not tha sayin which he spoke 2 ’em.
N he went down wit ’em, N came 2 Nazareth, N was subject 2 ’em: but his mother kept all dese sayings in her heart.
N Jesus increased in wisdom N stature, N in favour wit God N man.

3.text: Now in tha fifteenth year of tha reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate bein governor of Judæa, N Herod bein tetrarch of Galilee, N his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea N of tha region of Trachonitis, N Lysanias tha tetrarch of Abilene,
Annas N Caiaphas bein tha high priests, tha word of God came 2 John tha son of Zacharias in tha wilderness.
N he came in2 all tha country about Jordan, preachin tha baptism of repentance 4 tha remission of sins;
As it is written in tha book of tha words of Esaias tha prophet, sayin, tha voice of one cryin in tha wilderness, Prepare y’all tha way of tha Lord, make his paths straight.
Every valley shall be filled, N every mountain N hill shall be brought low; N tha crooked shall be made straight, N tha rough ways shall be made smooth;
N all flesh shall see tha salvation of God.
Then said he 2 tha crowd dat came forth 2 be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who has warned u 2 flee from tha wrath 2 come?
Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, N begin not 2 say within y’all, We have Abraham 2 our father: 4 I say 2 u, dat God is able of dese stones 2 raise up children 2 Abraham.
N now also tha axe is laid 2 tha root of tha trees: every tree therefore which brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, N cast in2 tha fire.
N tha people asked him, sayin, What shall we do then?
He answers N says 2 ’em, He dat has two coats, let him impart 2 him dat has none; N he dat has food, let him do likewise.
Then came also publicans 2 be baptized, N said 2 him, Master, what shall we do?
N he said 2 ’em, Exact no more than dat which is appointed u.
N tha soldiers likewise demanded of him, sayin, N what shall we do? N he said 2 ’em, Do violence 2 no man, neither accuse any falsely; N be content wit ur wages.
N as tha people were in expectation, N all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were tha Christ, or not;
John answered, sayin 2 ’em all, I indeed baptize u wit water; but one mightier than I comes, tha latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy 2 unloose: he shall baptize u wit tha Holy Ghost N wit fire:
Whose fan is in his hand, N he will throughly purge his floor, N will gather tha wheat in2 his garner; but tha chaff he will burn wit fire unquenchable.
N many other things in his exhortation preached he 2 tha people.
But Herod tha tetrarch, bein reproved by him 4 Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, N 4 all tha evils which Herod had done,
Added yet dis above all, dat he shut up John in prison.
Now when all tha people were baptized, it happened, dat Jesus also bein baptized, N prayin, tha heaven was opened,
N tha Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, N a voice came from heaven, which said, u r my beloved Son; in u I am well pleased.
N Jesus himself began 2 be about thirty years of age, bein (as was supposed) tha son of Joseph, which was tha son of Heli,
Which was tha son of Matthat, which was tha son of Levi, which was tha son of Melchi, which was tha son of Janna, which was tha son of Joseph,
Which was tha son of Mattathias, which was tha son of Amos, which was tha son of Naum, which was tha son of Esli, which was tha son of Nagge,
Which was tha son of Maath, which was tha son of Mattathias, which was tha son of Semei, which was tha son of Joseph, which was tha son of Juda,
Which was tha son of Joanna, which was tha son of Rhesa, which was tha son of Zorobabel, which was tha son of Salathiel, which was tha son of Neri,
Which was tha son of Melchi, which was tha son of Addi, which was tha son of Cosam, which was tha son of Elmodam, which was tha son of Er,
Which was tha son of Jose, which was tha son of Eliezer, which was tha son of Jorim, which was tha son of Matthat, which was tha son of Levi,
Which was tha son of Simeon, which was tha son of Juda, which was tha son of Joseph, which was tha son of Jonan, which was tha son of Eliakim,
Which was tha son of Melea, which was tha son of Menan, which was tha son of Mattatha, which was tha son of Nathan, which was tha son of David,
Which was tha son of Jesse, which was tha son of Obed, which was tha son of Booz, which was tha son of Salmon, which was tha son of Naasson,
Which was tha son of Aminadab, which was tha son of Aram, which was tha son of Esrom, which was tha son of Phares, which was tha son of Juda,
Which was tha son of Jacob, which was tha son of Isaac, which was tha son of Abraham, which was tha son of Thara, which was tha son of Nachor,
Which was tha son of Saruch, which was tha son of Ragau, which was tha son of Phalec, which was tha son of Heber, which was tha son of Sala,
Which was tha son of Cainan, which was tha son of Arphaxad, which was tha son of Sem, which was tha son of Noe, which was tha son of Lamech,
Which was tha son of Mathusala, which was tha son of Enoch, which was tha son of Jared, which was tha son of Maleleel, which was tha son of Cainan,
Which was tha son of Enos, which was tha son of Seth, which was tha son of Adam, which was tha son of God.

4.text: N Jesus bein full of tha Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, N was led by tha Spirit in2 tha wilderness,
Bein forty days tempted of tha devil. N in dose days he did eat nothing: N when dey were ended, he afterward hungered.
N tha devil said 2 him, If u be tha Son of God, command dis stone dat it be made bread.
N Jesus answered him, sayin, It is written, dat man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
N tha devil, takin him up in2 an high mountain, showed 2 him all tha kingdoms of tha world in a moment of time.
N tha devil said 2 him, All dis power will I give u, N tha glory of ’em: 4 dat is delivered 2 me; N 2 whoever I will I give it.
If u therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
N Jesus answered 2 him, Get u behind me, Satan: 4 it is written, u will worship tha Lord ur God, N him only will u serve.
N he brought him 2 Jerusalem, N set him on a pinnacle of tha temple, N said 2 him, If u be tha Son of God, cast urself down from hence:
4 it is written, He shall give his angels charge over u, 2 keep u:
N in their hands dey shall bear u up, lest at any time u dash ur foot against a stone.
N Jesus answerin said 2 him, It is said, u will not tempt tha Lord ur God.
N when tha devil had ended all tha temptation, he departed from him 4 a season.
N Jesus returned in tha power of tha Spirit in2 Galilee: N there went out a fame of him through all tha region round about.
N he taught in their synagogues, bein glorified of all.
N he came 2 Nazareth, where he had been brought up: N, as his custom was, he went in2 tha synagogue on tha sabbath day, N stood up 4 2 read.
N there was delivered 2 him tha book of tha prophet Esaias. N when he had opened tha book, he found tha place where it was written,

Tha Spirit of tha Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me 2 preach tha gospel 2 tha poor; he has sent me 2 heal tha brokenhearted, 2 preach deliverance 2 tha captives, N recovering of sight 2 tha blind, 2 set at liberty ’em dat r bruised,
2 preach tha acceptable year of tha Lord.
N he closed tha book, N he gave it again 2 tha minister, N sat down. N tha eyes of all ’em dat were in tha synagogue were fastened on him.
N he began 2 say 2 ’em, dis day is dis scripture fulfilled in ur ears.
N all bare him witness, N wondered at tha gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. N dey said, Is not dis Joseph’s son?
N he said 2 ’em, y’all will surely say 2 me dis proverb, Physician, heal urself: whatever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in ur country.
N he said, for real I say 2 u, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
But I tell u of a truth, many widows were in Israel in tha days of Elias, when tha heaven was shut up three years N six months, when great famine was throughout all tha land;
But 2 none of ’em was Elias sent, save 2 Sarepta, a city of Sidon, 2 a woman dat was a widow.
N many lepers were in Israel in tha time of Eliseus tha prophet; N none of ’em was cleansed, saving Naaman tha Syrian.
N all dey in tha synagogue, when dey heard dese things, were filled wit wrath,
N rose up, N thrust him out of tha city, N led him 2 tha brow of tha hill whereon their city was built, dat dey might cast him down headlong.
But he passing through tha midst of ’em went his way,
N came down 2 Capernaum, a city of Galilee, N taught ’em on tha sabbath days.
N dey were astonished at his doctrine: 4 his word was wit power.
N in tha synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, N cried out wit a loud voice,
Sayin, Let us alone; what have we 2 do wit u, u Jesus of Nazareth? r u come 2 destroy us? I know u who u r; tha Holy One of God.
N Jesus rebuked him, sayin, Hold ur peace, N come out of him. N when tha devil had thrown him in tha midst, he came out of him, N hurt him not.
N dey were all amazed, N spoke among themselves, sayin, What a word is dis! 4 wit authority N power he commands tha unclean spirits, N dey come out.
N tha fame of him went out in2 every place of tha country round about.
N he arose out of tha synagogue, N entered in2 Simon’s house. N Simon’s wife’s mother was taken wit a great fever; N dey besought him 4 her.
N he stood over her, N rebuked tha fever; N it left her: N right away she arose N ministered 2 ’em.
Now when tha sun was settin, all dey dat had any sick wit divers diseases brought ’em 2 him; N he laid his hands on every one of ’em, N healed ’em.
N devils also came out of many, cryin out, N sayin, u r Christ tha Son of God. N he rebuking ’em suffered ’em not 2 speak: 4 dey knew dat he was Christ.
N when it was day, he departed N went in2 a desert place: N tha people sought him, N came 2 him, N stayed him, dat he should not depart from ’em.
N he said 2 ’em, I must preach tha kingdom of God 2 other citiez also: 4 therefore am I sent.
N he preached in tha synagogues of Galilee.

5.text: N it happened, dat, as tha people pressed upon him 2 hear tha word of God, he stood by tha lake of Gennesaret,
N saw two ships standin by tha lake: but tha fishermen were gone out of ’em, N were washing their nets.
N he entered in2 one of tha ships, which was Simon’s, N prayed him dat he would thrust out a little from tha land. N he sat down, N taught tha people out of tha ship.
Now when he had left speakin, he said 2 Simon, Launch out in2 tha deep, N let down ur nets 4 a draught.
N Simon answerin said 2 him, Master, we have toiled all tha night, N have taken nothing: nevertheless at ur word I will let down tha net.
N when dey had dis done, dey inclosed a great crowd of fishes: N their net broke.
N dey beckoned 2 their partners, which were in tha other ship, dat dey should come N help ’em. N dey came, N filled both tha ships, so dat dey began 2 sink.
When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, sayin, Depart from me; 4 I am a sinful man, O Lord.
4 he was astonished, N all dat were wit him, at tha draught of tha fishes which dey had taken:
N so was also James, N John, tha sons of Zebedee, which were partners wit Simon. N Jesus said 2 Simon, don’t fear; from from now on u will catch men.
N when dey had brought their ships 2 land, dey forsook all, N followed him.
N it happened, when he was in a certain city, look a man full of leprosy: who seein Jesus fell on his face, N besought him, sayin, Lord, if u will, u can make me clean.
N he put forth his hand, N touched him, sayin, I will: be u clean. N right away tha leprosy departed from him.
N he charged him 2 tell no man: but go, N show urself 2 tha priest, N offer 4 ur cleansing, according as Moses commanded, 4 a testimony 2 ’em.
But so much tha more went there a fame abroad of him: N great crowds came together 2 hear, N 2 be healed by him of their infirmities.
N he withdrew himself in2 tha wilderness, N prayed.

N it happened on a certain day, as he was teachin, dat there were Pharisees N doctors of tha law sittin by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, N Judæa, N Jerusalem: N tha power of tha Lord was present 2 heal ’em.
N, look, men brought in a bed a man which was taken wit a palsy: N dey sought means 2 bring him in, N 2 lay him before him.
N when dey could not find by what way dey might bring him in because of tha crowd, dey went upon tha housetop, N let him down through tha tiling wit his couch in2 tha midst before Jesus.
N when he saw their faith, he said 2 him, Man, ur sins r forgiven u.
N tha scribes N tha Pharisees began 2 reason, sayin, Who is dis which speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answerin said 2 ’em, What reason y’all in ur hearts?
Whether is easier, 2 say, ur sins be forgiven u; or 2 say, Rise up N walk?
But dat y’all may know dat tha Son of man has power upon earth 2 forgive sins, (he said 2 tha sick of tha palsy,) I say 2 u, Arise, N take up ur couch, N go in2 thine house.
N right away he rose up before ’em, N took up dat whereon he lay, N departed 2 his own house, glorifying God.
N dey were all amazed, N dey glorified God, N were filled wit fear, sayin, We have seen strange things 2 day.
N after dese things he went forth, N saw a publican, named Levi, sittin at tha receipt of custom: N he said 2 him, Follow me.
N he left all, rose up, N followed him.
N Levi made him a great feast in his own house: N there was a great company of publicans N of others dat sat down wit ’em.
But their scribes N Pharisees grumbled against his disciples, sayin, Why do y’all eat N drink wit publicans N sinners?
N Jesus answerin said 2 ’em, dey dat r whole need not a physician; but dey dat r sick.
I came not 2 call tha righteous, but sinners 2 repentance.
N dey said 2 him, Why do tha disciples of John fast often, N make prayers, N likewise tha disciples of tha Pharisees; but thine eat N drink?
N he said 2 ’em, Can y’all make tha children of tha bridechamber fast, while tha bridegroom is wit ’em?
But tha days will come, when tha bridegroom shall be taken away from ’em, N then shall dey fast in dose days.
N he spoke also a parable 2 ’em; No man puts a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both tha new makes a rent, N tha piece dat was taken out of tha new agreeth not wit tha old.

N he spoke a parable 2 ’em, Can tha blind lead tha blind? shall dey not both fall in2 tha ditch?

N why beholdest u tha mote dat is in ur brother’s eye, but perceivest not tha beam dat is in ur own eye?

4 a good tree brings not forth corrupt fruit; neither does a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

u gave me no kiss: but dis woman since tha time I came in has not ceased 2 kiss my feet.

8.text: N it happened afterward, dat he went throughout every city N village, preachin N shewing tha glad tidings of tha kingdom of God: N tha twelve were wit him,

10.text: After dese things tha Lord appointed other seventy also, N sent ’em two N two before his face in2 every city N place, where he himself would come.

Even tha very dust of ur city, which clings on us, we do wipe off against u: even so be y’all sure of dis, dat tha kingdom of God is come nigh 2 u.

N u, Capernaum, which art exalted 2 heaven, will be thrust down 2 hell.
He dat hears u hears me; N he dat despiseth u despiseth me; N he dat despiseth me despiseth him dat sent me.

In dat hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, N said, I thank u, O Father, Lord of heaven N earth, dat u have hid dese things from tha wise N prudent, N have revealed ’em 2 babes: even so, Father; 4 so it seemed good in ur sight.

N he turned him 2 his disciples, N said privately, Blessed r tha eyes which see tha things dat y’all see:
4 I tell u, dat many prophets N kings have desired 2 see dose things which y’all see, N have not seen ’em; N 2 hear dose things which y’all hear, N have not heard ’em.
N, look, a certain lawyer stood up, N tempted him, sayin, Master, what shall I do 2 inherit eternal life?

N he answerin said, u will love tha Lord ur God wit all ur heart, N wit all ur soul, N wit all ur strength, N wit all ur mind; N ur neighbour as urself.

N Jesus answerin said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem 2 Jericho, N fell among thieves, which stripped him of his clothing, N wounded him, N departed, leavin him half dead.
N by chance there came down a certain priest dat way: N when he saw him, he passed by on tha other side.
N likewise a Levite, when he was at tha place, came N looked on him, N passed by on tha other side.
But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: N when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
N went 2 him, N bound up his wounds, pouring in oil N wine, N set him on his own beast, N brought him 2 an inn, N took care of him.
N on tha morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, N gave ’em 2 tha host, N said 2 him, Take care of him; N whatever u spendest more, when I come again, I will repay u.
Which now of dese three, think u, was neighbour 2 him dat fell among tha thieves?
N he said, He dat showed mercy on him. Then said Jesus 2 him, Go, N do u likewise.
Now it happened, as dey went, dat he entered in2 a certain village: N a certain woman named Martha received him in2 her house.
N she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, N heard his word.
But Martha was cumbered about much servin, N came 2 him, N said, Lord, do u not care dat my sister has left me 2 serve alone? bid her therefore dat she help me.
N Jesus answered 2 her, Martha, Martha, u r careful N troubled about many things:
But one thing is needful: N Mary has chosen dat good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

11.text: N it happened, dat, as he was prayin in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said 2 him, Lord, teach us 2 pray, as John also taught his disciples.

Give us day by day our daily bread.
N forgive us our sins; 4 we also forgive every one dat is indebted 2 us. N lead us not in2 temptation; but deliver us from evil.
N he said 2 ’em, Which of u shall have a friend, N shall go 2 him at midnight, N say 2 him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
4 a friend of mine in his journey is come 2 me, N I have nothing 2 set before him?
N he from within shall answer N say, Trouble me not: tha door is now shut, N my children r wit me in bed; I cannot rise N give u.
I say 2 u, Though he will not rise N give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise N give him as many as he needeth.
N I say 2 u, Ask, N it will be given u; seek, N y’all shall find; knock, N it will be opened 2 u.
4 every one dat asks receives; N he dat seeks finds; N 2 him dat knocketh it shall be opened.
If a son shall ask bread of any of u dat is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he 4 a fish give him a serpent?
Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
If y’all then, bein evil, know how 2 give good gifts 2 ur children: how much more shall ur heavenly Father give tha Holy Spirit 2 ’em dat ask him?
N he was castin out a devil, N it was dumb. N it happened, when tha devil was gone out, tha dumb spoke; N tha people wondered.
But some of ’em said, He casts out devils through Beelzebub tha chief of tha devils.
N others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
But he, knowin their thoughts, said 2 ’em, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought 2 desolation; N a house divided against a house falls.
If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because y’all say dat I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
N if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do ur sons cast ’em out? therefore shall dey be ur judges.

When a strong man armed keeps his palace, his goods r in peace:
But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, N overcome him, he takes from him all his armour in which he trusted, N divides his spoils.
He dat is not wit me is against me: N he dat gathers not wit me scatters.
When tha unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seekin rest; N finding none, he says, I will return 2 my house from where I came out.
N when he comes, he finds it swept N garnished.
Then goes he, N takes 2 him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; N dey enter in, N live there: N tha last state of dat man is worse than tha first.
N it happened, as he spoke dese things, a certain woman of tha company lifted up her voice, N said 2 him, Blessed is tha womb dat bare u, N tha paps which u have sucked.
But he said, yeah rather, blessed r dey dat hear tha word of God, N keep it.
N when tha people were gathered thick together, he began 2 say, dis is an evil generation: dey seek a sign; N there shall no sign be given it, but tha sign of Jonas tha prophet.
4 as Jonas was a sign 2 tha Ninevites, so shall also tha Son of man be 2 dis generation.

Tha queen of tha south shall rise up in tha judgment wit tha men of dis generation, N condemn ’em: 4 she came from tha utmost parts of tha earth 2 hear tha wisdom of Solomon; N, look, a greater than Solomon is here.
Tha men of Nineve shall rise up in tha judgment wit dis generation, N shall condemn it: 4 dey repented at tha preachin of Jonas; N, look, a greater than Jonas is here.
No man, when he has lighted a candle, puts it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, dat dey which come in may see tha light.
Tha light of tha body is tha eye: therefore when thine eye is single, ur whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, ur body also is full of darkness.
Pay attention therefore dat tha light which is in u don’t be darkness.
If ur whole body therefore be full of light, havin no part dark, tha whole shall be full of light, as when tha bright shinin of a candle does give u light.
N as he spoke, a certain Pharisee besought him 2 dine wit him: N he went in, N sat down 2 food.
N when tha Pharisee saw it, he marvelled dat he had not first washed before dinner.
N tha Lord said 2 him, Now do y’all Pharisees make clean tha outside of tha cup N tha platter; but ur inward part is full of ravening N wickedness.
y’all fools, did not he dat made dat which is without make dat which is within also?
But rather give alms of such things as y’all have; N, look, all things r clean 2 u.
But woe 2 u, Pharisees! 4 y’all tithe mint N rue N all manner of herbs, N pass over judgment N tha love of God: dese ought y’all 2 have done, N not 2 leave tha other undone.
Woe 2 u, Pharisees! 4 y’all love tha uppermost seats in tha synagogues, N greetings in tha markets.
Woe 2 u, scribes N Pharisees, hypocrites! 4 y’all r as graves which appear not, N tha men dat walk over ’em r not aware of ’em.
Then answered one of tha lawyers, N said 2 him, Master, like dis sayin u reproach us also.
N he said, woe 2 u also, y’all lawyers! 4 y’all lade men wit burdens grievous 2 be borne, N y’all y’all touch not tha burdens wit one of ur fingers.
Woe 2 u! 4 y’all build tha sepulchres of tha prophets, N ur fathers killed ’em.
Truly y’all bear witness dat y’all allow tha deeds of ur fathers: 4 dey indeed killed ’em, N y’all build their sepulchres.
Therefore also said tha wisdom of God, I will send ’em prophets N apostles, N some of ’em dey shall kill N persecute:
Dat tha blood of all tha prophets, which was shed from tha foundation of tha world, may be required of dis generation;
From tha blood of Abel 2 tha blood of Zacharias, which perished between tha altar N tha temple: for real I say 2 u, It shall be required of dis generation.
Woe 2 u, lawyers! 4 y’all have taken away tha key of knowledge: y’all entered not in y’all, N ’em dat were entering in y’all hindered.
N as he said dese things 2 ’em, tha scribes N tha Pharisees began 2 urge him vehemently, N 2 provoke him 2 speak of many things:
Laying wait 4 him, N seekin 2 catch something out of his mouth, dat dey might accuse him.

12.text: In tha mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable crowd of people, insomuch dat dey trode one upon another, he began 2 say 2 his disciples first of all, Beware y’all of tha leaven of tha Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
4 there is nothing covered, dat shall not be revealed; neither hid, dat shall not be known.
Therefore whatever y’all have spoken in darkness shall be heard in tha light; N dat which y’all have spoken in tha ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon tha housetops.
N I say 2 u my friends, don’t be afraid of ’em dat kill tha body, N after dat have no more dat dey can do.
But I will forewarn u whom y’all shall fear: Fear him, which after he has killed has power 2 cast in2 hell; yeah, I say 2 u, Fear him.
R not five sparrows sold 4 two farthings, N not one of ’em is forgotten before God?
But even tha very hairs of ur head r all numbered. don’t fear therefore: y’all r of more value than many sparrows.
Also I say 2 u, whoever shall confess me before men, him shall tha Son of man also confess before tha angels of God:
But he dat denieth me before men shall be denied before tha angels of God.
N whoever shall speak a word against tha Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but 2 him dat blasphemeth against tha Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
N when dey bring u 2 tha synagogues, N 2 magistrates, N powers, take y’all no thought how or what thing y’all shall answer, or what y’all shall say:
4 tha Holy Ghost shall teach u in tha same hour what y’all ought 2 say.
N one of tha company said 2 him, Master, speak 2 my brother, dat he divide tha inheritance wit me.
N he said 2 him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over u?
N he said 2 ’em, pay attention, N beware of covetousness: 4 a man’s life consisteth not in tha abundance of tha things which he possesseth.
N he spoke a parable 2 ’em, sayin, tha ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
N he thought within himself, sayin, What shall I do, because I have no room where 2 bestow my fruits?
N he said, dis will I do: I will pull down my barns, N build greater; N there will I bestow all my fruits N my goods.
N I will say 2 my soul, Soul, u have much goods laid up 4 many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, N be merry.
But God said 2 him, u fool, dis night ur soul shall be required of u: then whose shall dose things be, which u have provided?

N he said 2 his disciples, Therefore I say 2 u, Take no thought 4 ur life, what y’all shall eat; neither 4 tha body, what y’all shall put on.
Tha life is more than food, N tha body is more than clothing.
Consider tha ravens: 4 dey neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; N God feeds ’em: how much more r y’all better than tha fowls?
N which of u wit takin thought can add 2 his stature one cubit?
If y’all then don’t be able 2 do dat thing which is least, why take y’all thought 4 tha rest?
Consider tha lilies how dey grow: dey toil not, dey spin not; N yet I say 2 u, dat Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of dese.
If then God so clothe tha grass, which is 2 day in tha field, N 2 morrow is cast in2 tha oven; how much more will he clothe u, O y’all of little faith?
N seek not y’all what y’all shall eat, or what y’all shall drink, neither be y’all of doubtful mind.
4 all dese things do tha nations of tha world seek after: N ur Father knows dat y’all have need of dese things.

4 where ur treasure is, there will ur heart be also.
Let ur loins be girded about, N ur lights burnin;
N y’all y’all like 2 men dat wait 4 their lord, when he will return from tha wedding; dat when he comes N knocketh, dey may open 2 him right away.
Blessed r dose servants, whom tha lord when he comes shall find watchin: for real I say 2 u, dat he shall gird himself, N make ’em 2 sit down 2 food, N will come forth N serve ’em.
N if he shall come in tha second watch, or come in tha third watch, N find ’em so, blessed r dose servants.
N dis know, dat if tha goodman of tha house had known what hour tha thief would come, he would have watched, N not have suffered his house 2 be broken through.
Be y’all therefore ready also: 4 tha Son of man comes at an hour when y’all think not.
Then Peter said 2 him, Lord, speak u dis parable 2 us, or even 2 all?
N tha Lord said, Who then is dat faithful N wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, 2 give ’em their portion of food in due season?
Blessed is dat servant, whom his lord when he comes shall find so doin.
Of a truth I say 2 u, dat he will make him ruler over all dat he has.
But N if dat servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his comin; N shall begin 2 beat tha menservants N maidens, N 2 eat N drink, N 2 be drunken;
Tha lord of dat servant will come in a day when he looks not 4 him, N at an hour when he is not aware, N will cut him in sunder, N will appoint him his portion wit tha unbelievers.
N dat servant, which knew his lord’s will, N prepared not himself, neither did according 2 his will, shall be beaten wit many stripes.

But he dat knew not, N did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten wit few stripes. 4 2 whoever much is given, of him shall be much required: N 2 whom men have committed much, of him dey will ask tha more.
I am come 2 send fire on tha earth; N what will I, if it be already kindled?
But I have a baptism 2 be baptized wit; N how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
Suppose y’all dat I am come 2 give peace on earth? I tell u, no; but rather division:
4 from from now on there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, N two against three.

Tha father shall be divided against tha son, N tha son against tha father; tha mother against tha daughter, N tha daughter against tha mother; tha mother in law against her daughter in law, N tha daughter in law against her mother in law.
N he said also 2 tha people, When y’all see a cloud rise out of tha west, right away y’all say, There comes a shower; N so it is.
N when y’all see tha south wind blow, y’all say, There will be heat; N it happens.
y’all hypocrites, y’all can discern tha face of tha sky N of tha earth; but how is it dat y’all do not discern dis time?
Yeah, N why even of y’all judge y’all not what is right?

When u go wit thine adversary 2 tha magistrate, as u r in tha way, give diligence dat u may be delivered from him; lest he hale u 2 tha judge, N tha judge deliver u 2 tha officer, N tha officer cast u in2 prison.
I tell u, u will not depart thence, till u have paid tha very last mite.

N he was teachin in one of tha synagogues on tha sabbath.

When once tha master of tha house is risen up, N has shut 2 tha door, N y’all begin 2 stand without, N 2 knock at tha door, sayin, Lord, Lord, open 2 us; N he shall answer N say 2 u, I know u not from where y’all r:

N he put forth a parable 2 dose which were bidden, when he marked how dey chose out tha chief rooms; sayin 2 ’em,

Then said he also 2 him dat told him, When u make a dinner or a supper, call not ur friends, nor ur brothers, neither ur kinsmen, nor ur rich neighbours; lest dey also bid u again, N a recompence be made u.

N u will be blessed; 4 dey cannot recompense u: 4 u will be recompensed at tha resurrection of tha just.
N when one of ’em dat sat at food wit him heard dese things, he said 2 him, Blessed is he dat shall eat bread in tha kingdom of God.
Then said he 2 him, A certain man made a great supper, N told many:
N sent his servant at supper time 2 say 2 ’em dat were bidden, Come; 4 all things r now ready.
N dey all wit one consent began 2 make excuse. tha first said 2 him, I have bought a piece of ground, N I must needs go N see it: I pray u have me excused.

N there went great crowds wit him: N he turned, N said 2 ’em,

4 which of u, intending 2 build a tower, sits not down first, N counteth tha cost, whether he have sufficient 2 finish it?

15.text: Then drew near 2 him all tha publicans N sinners 4 2 hear him.

N he said, A certain man had two sons:
N tha younger of ’em said 2 his father, Father, give me tha portion of goods dat falls 2 me. N he divided 2 ’em his livin.
N not many days after tha younger son gathered all together, N took his journey in2 a far country, N there wasted his substance wit riotous livin.

N he would fain have filled his belly wit tha husks dat tha swine did eat: N no man gave 2 him.
N when he came 2 himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough N 2 spare, N I perish wit hunger!
I will arise N go 2 my father, N will say 2 him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, N before u,
N am no more worthy 2 be called ur son: make me as one of ur hired servants.
N he arose, N came 2 his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, N had compassion, N ran, N fell on his neck, N kissed him.
N tha son said 2 him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, N in ur sight, N am no more worthy 2 be called ur son.

16.text: N he said also 2 his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; N tha same was accused 2 him dat he had wasted his goods.

17.text: Then said he 2 tha disciples, It is impossible but dat offences will come: but woe 2 him, through whom dey come!

N it happened, as he went 2 Jerusalem, dat he passed through tha midst of Samaria N Galilee.

18.text: N he spoke a parable 2 ’em 2 dis end, dat men ought always 2 pray, N not 2 faint;

N a certain ruler asked him, sayin, Good Master, what shall I do 2 inherit eternal life?

u know tha commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour ur father N ur mother.
N he said, All dese have I kept from my youth up.

N it happened, dat as he was come nigh 2 Jericho, a certain blind man sat by tha way side begging:
N hearin tha crowd pass by, he asked what it meant.

N dey which went before rebuked him, dat he should hold his peace: but he cried so much tha more, u Son of David, have mercy on me.
N Jesus stood, N commanded him 2 be brought 2 him: N when he was come near, he asked him,
Sayin, What will u dat I shall do 2 u? N he said, Lord, dat I may receive my sight.

19.text: N Jesus entered N passed through Jericho.

N as dey heard dese things, he added N spoke a parable, because he was nigh 2 Jerusalem, N because dey thought dat tha kingdom of God should right away appear.

N another came, sayin, Lord, look, here is ur pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

N when he had like dis spoken, he went before, ascending up 2 Jerusalem.

N dey dat were sent went their way, N found even as he had said 2 ’em.

20.text: N it happened, dat on one of dose days, as he taught tha people in tha temple, N preached tha gospel, tha chief priests N tha scribes came upon him wit tha elders,

N he sent Peter N John, sayin, Go N prepare us tha passover, dat we may eat.
N dey said 2 him, Where will u dat we prepare?
N he said 2 ’em, look, when y’all r entered in2 tha city, there shall a man meet u, bearin a pitcher of water; follow him in2 tha house where he enters in.
N y’all shall say 2 tha goodman of tha house, tha Master says 2 u, Where is tha guestchamber, where I shall eat tha passover wit my disciples?
N he shall show u a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
N dey went, N found as he had said 2 ’em: N dey made ready tha passover.
N when tha hour was come, he sat down, N tha twelve apostles wit him.
N he said 2 ’em, wit desire I have desired 2 eat dis passover wit u before I suffer:
4 I say 2 u, I will not any more eat of it, until it be fulfilled in tha kingdom of God.
N he took tha cup, N gave thanks, N said, Take dis, N divide it among y’all:
4 I say 2 u, I will not drink of tha fruit of tha vine, until tha kingdom of God shall come.
N he took bread, N gave thanks, N broke it, N gave 2 ’em, sayin, dis is my body which is given 4 u: dis do in remembrance of me.

But, look, tha hand of him dat betrayeth me is wit me on tha table.
N truly tha Son of man goes, as it was determined: but woe 2 dat man by whom he is betrayed!
N dey began 2 enquire among themselves, which of ’em it was dat should do dis thing.

N he said 2 ’em, tha kings of tha Gentiles exercise lordship over ’em; N dey dat exercise authority upon ’em r called benefactors.
But y’all shall not be so: but he dat is greatest among u, let him be as tha younger; N he dat is chief, as he dat does serve.
4 whether is greater, he dat sits at food, or he dat serves? is not he dat sits at food? but I am among u as he dat serves.
y’all r dey which have continued wit me in my temptations.
N I appoint 2 u a kingdom, as my Father has appointed 2 me;
Dat y’all may eat N drink at my table in my kingdom, N sit on thrones judgin tha twelve tribes of Israel.
N tha Lord said, Simon, Simon, look, Satan has desired 2 have u, dat he may sift u as wheat:

Then said he 2 ’em, But now, he dat has a purse, let him take it, N likewise his scrip: N he dat has no sword, let him sell his garment, N buy one.
4 I say 2 u, dat dis dat is written must yet be accomplished in me, N he was reckoned among tha transgressors: 4 tha things concerning me have an end.
N dey said, Lord, look, here r two swords. N he said 2 ’em, It is enough.
N he came out, N went, as he was wont, 2 tha mount of Olives; N his disciples also followed him.
N when he was at tha place, he said 2 ’em, Pray dat y’all enter not in2 temptation.
N he was withdrawn from ’em about a stone’s cast, N kneeled down, N prayed,
Sayin, Father, if u be willin, remove dis cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
N there appeared an angel 2 him from heaven, strengthening him.

Then took dey him, N led him, N brought him in2 tha high priest’s house. N Peter followed afar off.
N when dey had kindled a fire in tha midst of tha hall, N were set down together, Peter sat down among ’em.
But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by tha fire, N earnestly looked upon him, N said, dis man was also wit him.

N Peter said, Man, I know not what u sayest. N right away, while he yet spoke, tha cock crew.
N tha Lord turned, N looked upon Peter. N Peter remembered tha word of tha Lord, how he had said 2 him, Before tha cock crow, u will deny me thrice.
N Peter went out, N wept bitterly.
N tha men dat held Jesus mocked him, N struck him.
N when dey had blindfolded him, dey struck him on tha face, N asked him, sayin, Prophesy, who is it dat struck u?
N many other things blasphemously spoke dey against him.
N as soon as it was day, tha elders of tha people N tha chief priests N tha scribes came together, N led him in2 their council, sayin,
R u tha Christ? tell us. N he said 2 ’em, If I tell u, y’all will not believe:

23.text: N tha whole crowd of ’em arose, N led him 2 Pilate.

N Pilate, when he had called together tha chief priests N tha rulers N tha people,
Said 2 ’em, y’all have brought dis man 2 me, as one dat perverteth tha people: N, look, I, havin examined him before u, have found no fault in dis man touching dose things whereof y’all accuse him:

(4 of necessity he must release one 2 ’em at tha feast.)

N Pilate gave sentence dat it should be as dey required.
N he released 2 ’em him dat 4 sedition N murder was cast in2 prison, whom dey had desired; but he delivered Jesus 2 their will.
N as dey led him away, dey laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, comin out of tha country, N on him dey laid tha cross, dat he might bear it after Jesus.
N there followed him a great company of people, N of women, which also bewailed N lamented him.

4, look, tha days r comin, in tha which dey shall say, Blessed r tha barren, N tha wombs dat never bare, N tha paps which never gave suck.

4 if dey do dese things in a green tree, what shall be done in tha dry?
N there were also two other, malefactors, led wit him 2 be put 2 death.

N tha people stood beholding. N tha rulers also wit ’em derided him, sayin, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, tha chosen of God.
N tha soldiers also mocked him, comin 2 him, N offering him vinegar,

N he said 2 Jesus, Lord, remember me when u come in2 ur kingdom.

N it was about tha sixth hour, N there was a darkness over all tha earth until tha ninth hour.

24.text: Now upon tha first day of tha week, very early in tha morning, dey came 2 tha sepulchre, bringin tha spices which dey had prepared, N certain others wit ’em.

N as dey were afraid, N bowed down their faces 2 tha earth, dey said 2 ’em, Why seek y’all tha livin among tha dead?

N dey remembered his words,
